svg.text: SciFi: scientific manuscripts from findings to inference
One repo, three ways to run it (Claude Code plugin, copied .claude/ folder, claude.ai skills). Three actors. Every handoff is a JSON file in the workspace, validated on write.
the standards from 14 papers, checker, checklist, journals
central claim, gap, results, threads of evidence
reverse outline per section from the threads
the paragraph loop: map, 5 checks, draft, gate (loop.md)
figure and table brainstorm, captions, corpus figures
scout, notes, ontology, labels, evidence lookup
Word with live Zotero citations, then Google Docs
which biostatistical method, with a complexity guard
sonnet, medium previous and next unit
sonnet, medium claims vs sources and results
inherit: one pass, PASS or RETURN
validate_json, state, init_workspace, bbt_check, export_docx, schemas/
the invented echo study, every JSON valid
protocol, workflows, architecture, zotero-guide, this figure
the 28 paper analyses behind the standards
MASTER (your session model: Opus or Fable)
SUB-AGENTS (isolated, one JSON brief in, one JSON envelope out)
Types a command or a phrase
full pipeline, or resume from STATE.json
analysis plan: the standard method for the question
Decides at gates: picks one option, approves diffs, answers NEED requests.
Owns Manuscript/ and Literature/. The system reads them and never edits them.
state.py session; read STATE.json and the last decisions
claim, gap, results R1.., threads T1.. spine.json
units with takeaway and thread skeleton.json
brief, store envelopes, synthesis, draft, gate
Only writer of STATE.json, spine, skeleton, figures, syntheses and the decisions log,
through state.py. Reads one unit, its logic.json and five envelopes at a time.
The paragraph loop for one unit
claims, evidence, steps of the text units/<id>.logic.json
internal: one point, context first, takeaway last, old to new
neighbours: redundancy, pre-emption, bridge, single home
spine and results: serves the claim, same gap, no new data
each claim vs cited source, our results, or a logical step
runs check_manuscript.py, then the section standards
redrafts from logic.json and the accepted findings units/<id>.draft.md
one pass: PASS, or RETURN with three blockers
five checks run in parallel; the two inherit agents run after
options with one pick at each gate
question, data, method, what is reported
review comments with severity and fix
read first; rewritten by the ritual
Human owns Manuscript/ and Literature/; the system never edits them.
Master owns Thinking-space/ and is the only writer of shared files.
Sub-agents read only the paths in their brief and return one envelope.
validate-json rejects any malformed JSON on write (exit 2).
No number that is not in results.md; no source that is not in the library.
A missing source is a NEED, never a guess. A missing envelope is not a pass.
Resume = STATE.json, then the tail of log/decisions.jsonl.
Accepted units are never redrafted; human edits are never overwritten.
Standards: sentences 15 to 30 words, no colons, semicolons or dashes,
no promotional words, every claim with its evidence in the same sentence.

Run it: /plugin marketplace add Sdamirsa/SciFi, then /plugin install scifi@scifi (Claude Code); scripts/install_local.sh <project> to copy into .claude/; dist/scifi-lite.skill and dist/scientific-writing.skill for claude.ai.
